non_blocking_issues.N1_baseline_diversity_is_cosmetic: The 15 'fair/graph-cache/lookup' producers are aliases of one function predict_from_budget_components (identical source bodies, identical predictions). 'Six graph-cache challengers = 1.0' is one computation reported six times, not six independent challengers. ACCEPTABLE for a no-headroom STOP (the cheapest legal-channel route saturating is sufficient, and the score equals what a faithful budget-respecting graph_lookup/count_table would yield over the same 5 channels). MUST NOT be cited as independent corroboration, and MUST NOT be reused as-is for any positive headroom claim, candidate tournament, or BASELINE-IMMUNITY-ADMISSION-STANDARD-001A admission, where genuinely distinct implementations are required (there it would be a blocking under-powered-battery defect).
non_blocking_issues.N2_strategy_class_alignment_non_fail_abl: run_strategy_class_alignment compares two hardcoded-identical literal dicts (build_oracle_strategy_class vs build_strongest_classical_strategy_class); all 7 checks compare equal literals, so the producer can never return failed for any actual code. Consumed by the verdict but evidentially near-empty. The self-check's strategy_class_mismatch_blocks case only passes because it manually injects result=failed into a synthetic context; it does not exercise the real builder. Do not count as real B2 alignment evidence.
non_blocking_issues.N3_oracle_budget_subcontrols_near_vacuou: hidden_field_ablation (mask) and hidden_field_permutation pass vacuously because the oracle reads only BUDGET_COMPONENT_CHANNELS and never reads hidden_state/target, so masking/permuting them cannot change predictions by construction. The forbidden-token scan IS fail-able but runs over the oracle's self-declared consumed_field_manifest (hardcoded), so a future oracle reading a forbidden field without declaring it would evade it. For the current oracle, code inspection confirms it reads only legal channels; non-blocking but the control is weaker than 'passed' implies.
non_blocking_issues.N4_leakage_is_name_token_only: Leakage positive control is a real fail-able token detector but scans only forbidden field-NAME tokens (answer_key, hidden_state, target_label, stored_prediction). It does not test value-level leakage (a visible field numerically equal to the target). Here it happens not to matter (passive max 0.40 confirms no value-level leakage lets passive solve it), but the control is name-level not value-level.
non_blocking_issues.N5_thresholds_and_generator_in_unfrozen_: The freeze pins only the spec .md sha256 (enforced). The numeric thresholds (band 0.03, ceilings 0.87, floor 0.90) and the target rule + generator live in minimal_env_spec_loader_001a.py and baseline_battery_001a.py, which are recorded at run-time via generator provenance but with NO frozen expected hash enforced by the verdict. Mitigated because: (a) the decisive saturation gate has margin exactly 0.0, which triggers for any positive band, so band-tuning cannot change the verdict; degenerate 0.19 / passive 0.40 sit far below 0.87; visible 1.0 > floor 0.90; (b) the .py values match the spec .md (lines 232-236). Non-blocking provenance-completeness caveat; a stronger freeze would pin loader/battery source hashes with enforced comparison.
non_blocking_issues.N6_per_class_floors_not_enforced: Spec lines 232-237 require per-class precision floor 0.85 and recall floor 0.85; the verdict logic uses only scalar macro_f1 family comparisons and does not enforce per-class floors. Moot for the no-headroom path (saturation decided by margin=0), but it WOULD matter on the headroom_confirmed path; flag for any future headroom run.
